name: Contracts
purpose: the Effect Schema types and the HttpApi contract the OpenAPI document is generated from

name: Domain
purpose: the pure policy rules in TypeScript, with no I/O, one folder per capability

name: Database
purpose: the Drizzle schema, Drizzle Kit migrations and Effect SQL queries on PostgreSQL
check: bunx tsc --noEmit && bunx vitest run --passWithNoTests && bunx drizzle-kit check

name: API service
purpose: the Effect HttpApi handlers served on Bun, which carry the outside systems and call domain and database

name: UI components
purpose: the shadcn on Base UI components, Tailwind 4 styles and lucide icons, shown in Storybook
check: bunx tsc --noEmit && bunx vitest run --passWithNoTests && bunx storybook build --test

name: Web app
purpose: the TanStack Start screens, routes, Query and Form wiring and Paraglide messages

name: End-to-end tests
purpose: the Playwright and axe tests that drive the running product, committed before the code they test

name: Tooling
purpose: the shared ESLint, Prettier, knip, markdownlint, commitlint and lefthook configuration
check: bunx eslint . && bunx prettier --check . && bunx knip
